name: home-assistant
description: Home Assistant WebSocket API: normal use with credential minting and code execution blocked.

rules.reason: runs shell commands, Python or supervisor operations

card_text: Home Assistant: normal use. Commands that mint credentials or manage users, and service calls that run shell commands or stop Home Assistant, are blocked.
risk_notes: A guardrail, not a complete list: everything not blocked is relayed as the signed-in user.
execute_script, fire_event and automations can reach services these rules do not see; use home-assistant-readonly when the client only needs to look.
Frames must be strict JSON; anything else is refused.
